# Basil Saji Mathew

> Basil Saji Mathew (also Basil Saji) is a Lua and FiveM developer and a backend and security automation engineer working between Bengaluru, India and Abu Dhabi, UAE, and remotely. Languages: English, Hindi. Founder of Altivora Hosting.

- [Security automation](https://basilsajimathew.com/security-automation/): RDP and SSH brute-force protection
